import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
bundle = pathlib.Path(os.environ['REVIEW_BUNDLE'])
plugin = pathlib.Path('/home/sergio/.codex/plugins/cache/fr-opus55-581dd0e1-20261011/kk/0.23.0')
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args])
base = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip()
paths = ['README.md', 'reader.py', 'api.py', 'writer.py', 'migration.py', 'data/records.json', 'tests/test_destinations.py']
provenance = []
for category, rev in [('candidate', ':'), ('historical', base + ':')]:
    for path in paths:
        data = git('show', rev + path)
        out = bundle / category / path
        out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        out.write_bytes(data)
        out.chmod(0o444)
        provenance.append({'category': category, 'repository': str(root), 'revision': base if category == 'historical' else 'staged index over ' + base, 'original_path': path, 'git_blob': git('rev-parse', rev + path).decode().strip(), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'line_span': [1, len(data.splitlines())], 'omitted_or_redacted': 'none', 'evidence_path': str(out)})
diff = bundle / 'staged.patch'
diff.write_bytes(git('diff', '--cached', '--binary', '--no-ext-diff', '--'))
diff.chmod(0o444)
common = ['functional-review.md', 'shared-change-context.md', 'shared-review-scope-protocol.md', 'shared-capy-knowledge-protocol.md']
checklists = ['security-checklist.md', 'solid-checklist.md', 'code-quality-checklist.md', 'removal-plan.md']
criteria = [str(plugin / 'skills/review-code' / p) for p in common] + [str(plugin / 'profiles/python/review-code' / p) for p in checklists]
assert len(criteria) == len(set(criteria)) == 8
assert all(pathlib.Path(p).is_file() for p in criteria)
context = {
 'intent_and_authority': 'User requests isolated review of staged destination reader cleanup. README.md explicitly requires legacy top-level address and nested destination.address reads during bounded background migration; existing addresses must be preserved.',
 'task_scope': 'No task scope available — review the diff on its own merits without assuming any feature-level design doc.',
 'selector': 'git diff --cached; only reader.py changed, +1/-3 lines. Worktree matches index.',
 'base': base,
 'candidate': 'Index reader.py blob ' + git('rev-parse', ':reader.py').decode().strip() + ' over base ' + base,
 'compatibility_baseline': 'Supported mixed data snapshot from data/records.json at review base; no named release or deployed environment. Compare before, during, and after bounded migration against documented read contract.',
 'delivery_constraints': 'README: background migration in bounded batches, reads remain available, both shapes readable until migration finishes, no startup migration gate. Local JSON model, no external database or production access needed.',
 'entrypoints_and_consumers': 'api.list_destinations -> reader.address_of; writer.new_destination produces nested records; migration.migrate_batch mutates legacy records in bounded batches.',
 'verification': 'Existing test source inspected; no execution yet. Parent will supply any later observed execution as attributed evidence.',
 'knowledge_search': 'kk:review-findings and kk:lang-idioms searches returned empty knowledge base.',
 'rejected_approaches': 'None supplied.',
 'external_reviewer': 'PAL tools/listmodels unavailable; degraded isolated review with code-reviewer only.'
}
manifest = {'instructions': criteria, 'review_evidence': [str(diff)] + [p['evidence_path'] for p in provenance if p['category'] == 'candidate'], 'historical_evidence': [p['evidence_path'] for p in provenance if p['category'] == 'historical'], 'provenance': str(bundle / 'provenance.json'), 'intent_context': str(bundle / 'context.json'), 'criteria_set_check': 'Four common files plus all four resolved Python checklists; exact set reconciled with loading ledger.'}
for name, value in [('provenance.json', provenance), ('context.json', context), ('manifest.json', manifest)]:
    out = bundle / name
    out.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\\n')
    out.chmod(0o444)
print(json.dumps({'bundle': str(bundle), 'manifest': manifest, 'context': context}, indent=2))
